findings.title: Replacement-20 supervisor and admission disagree on the production experiment marker
findings.scope: BF20 durable parent-admission integration; no analyzer or measurement conclusion
findings.detail: The frozen supervisor-20 source defines EXPERIMENT_ENV as DATAFLOWBENCH_V092_REPLACEMENT20_EXPERIMENT and the launch preflight injects exactly that marker. The frozen admission-20 source defines EXPERIMENT_ENV as DATAFLOWBENCH_V092_REPLACEMENT18_EXPERIMENT; its production _require_execution_permission guard therefore rejects the actual environment in admit_parent. This is a source/entrypoint contract mismatch, not a missing authorization or capacity failure.
findings.required_correction: Create an append-only successor whose admission production permission constant and supervisor/launcher environment are bound to the same successor-specific marker. Keep fixture-only checks separate, reject the old marker and missing-marker near misses, exercise the real durable supervisor CLI through run_groups -> admit_parent with the exact manifest/source/plan/contract identities, and require a fresh source/core/manifest/launch review before another invocation. Do not mutate or reuse the stopped BF20 namespace.
